verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never mentions integrating an organization's identity provider (SSO/SAML/OIDC) to gate internal apps, deployments, or agents. The closest items do not qualify: [cloudflare-docs-18] is only a generic marketing line that "Zero Trust controls" are built into the network, with no IdP detail. The MCP OAuth flow and API tokens are Cloudflare-account authorization, an adjacent control rather than org-IdP-based access.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can secure internal apps, deployments, and agents using my organization's identity provider
